Entries.Source: 顾客已经把东西收回去了，这次不能再指认。
Entries.Text: The customer has taken the item back. No more claims this visit.

Entries.Source: 这处已经记录过了。
Entries.Text: Already recorded.

Entries.Source: 这里没看出异常。
Entries.Text: Nothing unusual there.

Entries.Source: “那里根本没毛病。不看了。”顾客把东西收了回去。
Entries.Text: "There is nothing wrong there. I am done with this." The customer takes the item back.

Entries.Source: “那里没问题吧？你看仔细点。”
Entries.Text: "There is nothing wrong there, is there? Look properly."

Entries.Source: 实测成色：{0}
Entries.Text: Assay: {0}

Entries.Source: 印记：{0}｜成色：未检测
Entries.Text: Mark: {0} | Assay: not tested

Entries.Source: 宝石筛查笔
Entries.Text: Gem Screening Probe

Entries.Source: 筛查结果：建议送实验室检测。
Entries.Text: Screening: refer for laboratory testing.

Entries.Source: 筛查结果：未见明显仿制品。这不能证明天然来源，也不能排除处理。
Entries.Text: Screening: no obvious substitute detected. This does not confirm natural origin or treatment.

Entries.Source: 这位顾客没有委托付费鉴定。
Entries.Text: This customer did not ask for a paid appraisal.

Entries.Source: 请填写不小于零的估价。
Entries.Text: Enter an estimate of zero or more.

Entries.Source: 鉴定费已经结清。
Entries.Text: The appraisal fee was already settled.

Entries.Source: “这不可能。我去问问别家。”
Entries.Text: "That cannot be right. I will ask someone else."

Entries.Source: “嗯，和别处说的差不太多。”
Entries.Text: "Hm. Roughly what I heard elsewhere."

Entries.Source: “听着公道。谢谢。”
Entries.Text: "That sounds fair. Thank you."

Entries.Source: “这正是我想知道的。多谢。”
Entries.Text: "Exactly what I needed to know. Thank you."

Entries.Source: 现在没有可以接受的报价。
Entries.Text: There is no offer to accept.

Entries.Source: 顾客已经带着东西离开了。
Entries.Text: The customer has already left with the item.

Entries.Source: 现金不够，买不下这件东西。
Entries.Text: You do not have enough cash for this purchase.

Entries.Source: 可出借的现金不够放这笔款。
Entries.Text: You do not have enough lendable cash for this loan.

Entries.Source: 这件东西已经不在了。
Entries.Text: The item is no longer available.

Entries.Source: 按现状，这件东西没有可放款的价值。
Entries.Text: There is no lendable value in this item as it stands.

Entries.Source: 要先做成色检测，才能按所称含金量放款。
Entries.Text: A material test is needed before I can lend against the claimed gold content.

Entries.Source: “行，痛快点。这个价你收不收？”
Entries.Text: "Fine. Make it quick. Will you take it at that?"

Entries.Source: “比我想的还多。你愿意收吗？”
Entries.Text: "That is more than I expected. Would you buy it?"

Entries.Source: “我还是卖了吧。你有兴趣吗？”
Entries.Text: "I would rather sell it. Are you interested?"

Entries.Source: “我舍不得卖。能不能押在你这儿借点钱？”
Entries.Text: "I cannot part with it. Could you hold it for me against a loan?"

Entries.Source: “我急用钱，但还想赎回来。能押在这儿吗？”
Entries.Text: "I need cash, but I want this back. Can I leave it as security?"

Entries.Source: “有用。这件我留着收藏。”
Entries.Text: "Useful. I will keep it in the collection."

Entries.Source: “谢谢。我先留着。”
Entries.Text: "Thanks. I will keep it for now."

Entries.Source: “镀的？没人跟我说过……”顾客移开了目光。
Entries.Text: "Plated? Nobody told me that..." The customer looks away.

Entries.Source: “我拿到的时候就这样。大概吧。”
Entries.Text: "That was there when I got it. Probably."

Entries.Source: “知道了，算进价里。”
Entries.Text: "Noted. Price it in."

Entries.Source: “我也怀疑过那里。请继续。”
Entries.Text: "I had wondered about that. Go on."

Entries.Source: “严重吗？我只想知道它值多少。”
Entries.Text: "Is it bad? I just need to know what it is worth."

Entries.Source: “不是足金？我可是按足金买的……”
Entries.Text: "It is not solid? I paid for solid gold..."

Entries.Source: “哦，我从没注意到。”
Entries.Text: "Oh. I never noticed that."

Entries.Source: 这道工序现在做不了。
Entries.Text: This process is not available.

Entries.Source: 请放入一件到上限数量之间的原料。
Entries.Text: Choose between one and the allowed number of inputs.

Entries.Source: 有物品正在质押、加工中，或不属于你。
Entries.Text: An input is pledged, in service, or not yours.

Entries.Source: 这道工序不能处理这件东西。
Entries.Text: This process cannot take that input.

Entries.Source: 缺少所需的机器或器具。
Entries.Text: The required machine or equipment is missing.

Entries.Source: 现金不够支付加工费。
Entries.Text: You do not have enough cash for the service fee.

Entries.Source: 储能不足。请装入一块充满的能源电池。
Entries.Text: Not enough stored energy. Add a charged cell.

Entries.Source: 请使用你自己的满电能源电池。
Entries.Text: Use a charged energy cell you own.

Entries.Source: 炉料里的金属不够配这种合金。
Entries.Text: The charge does not contain enough metal for this alloy.

Entries.Source: 这项加工还没完成。
Entries.Text: This job is still running.

Entries.Source: 放不下产出。它会留在这里等你来取。
Entries.Text: No room for the output. It stays ready to collect.

Entries.Source: 那不是戒托或镶座。
Entries.Text: That is not a setting.

Entries.Source: 这个镶座里已经有宝石了。
Entries.Text: This setting already holds a stone.

Entries.Source: 每个镶口都需要正好一颗宝石。
Entries.Text: Each socket needs exactly one stone.

Entries.Source: 这颗宝石不适配这个镶座。
Entries.Text: This stone does not fit this setting.

Entries.Source: 同一件首饰上的宝石必须是同一种。
Entries.Text: Stones in one piece must be the same kind.

Entries.Source: 这项工作需要珠宝工作台和工具包。
Entries.Text: This work needs the jeweler's bench and toolkit.

Entries.Source: 这件首饰现在做不了这项服务。
Entries.Text: This piece cannot take that service as it is.

Entries.Source: 这个镶座里没有宝石。
Entries.Text: There is no stone in this setting.

Entries.Source: 这件东西没有工作台能修的地方。
Entries.Text: Nothing here can be repaired at the bench.

Entries.Source: 实验室只鉴定散石或已镶嵌的宝石。
Entries.Text: The laboratory only identifies loose or mounted stones.

Entries.Source: 这颗宝石已有一份有效报告。
Entries.Text: This stone already has a current report.

Entries.Source: 订单需要写明价格和今天之后的交期。
Entries.Text: The order needs a price and a deadline after today.

Entries.Source: 这份订单要用的每件东西都必须在手且未被占用。
Entries.Text: Every part for this order must be on hand and free.

Entries.Source: 这份订单现在不能这样操作。
Entries.Text: This order cannot do that now.

Entries.Source: 这件首饰还没做好，不能交付。
Entries.Text: The piece is not ready to hand over.

Entries.Source: 请先从工作台取回成品再取消。
Entries.Text: Collect the bench work before cancelling.
